# Code Anchors: Authored Component Root

- `libs/portable-tools/src/vendor-components.ts` — the one definition of the authored root's directory name, the derivation of that root in this checkout, and the derivation of an arbitrary checkout's authored tree.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/authored-root.spec.ts` — asserts the root is an ordinary tracked directory the harness does not load, that it carries the managed subtrees, and that nothing Nexus owns — and nothing tracked at all — sits under the loaded path.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/authoring-source-sites.spec.ts` — the derived inventory: every tracked non-test TypeScript source searched for the loaded directory's name, the waiver set enumerated with a written reason per file, the stale-waiver check, and the check that the former helper name survives nowhere.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/contributor-docs.spec.ts` — asserts the contributor guide exists, names the authored tree, states the loaded directory is not it, describes the pointing loop, is reachable from both entry points, and that no fenced instruction places components at the loaded path.
- `components/` — the authored tree itself: the commands, agents and skills subtrees, relocated with their internal shape preserved.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — the contributor guide those checks assert: where the tree is authored, why the loaded directory is not it, and the maintainer's point-at-the-checkout loop run from source.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-payload.ts` — payload assembly, one of the consumers that derives the root rather than naming it.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-gate.ts` — the shipped-body scanner, another consumer reaching the tree through the same derivation.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/supported-arrangement.spec.ts` — the shipped-body check, re-aimed at the authored root by that same derivation.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/pack-release.spec.ts` — the regression check that a release built after the move stages exactly the component files the committed payload manifest records.
- `CLAUDE.md` — the agent-instruction pointer naming the authored tree and directing to the contributor guide.
- `README.md` — the adopter-facing pointer to the contributor guide, and the removal of the loaded-path component listing.
- `docs/delivery/release-procedure.md` — the component-diff step, now reading the authored tree.
